hooks.command: bash -c 'FILE=$(cat | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); [[ "$FILE" != *.py ]] && exit 0; cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}" || exit 0; uv run ruff check --fix "$FILE" >/dev/null 2>&1; uv run ruff format "$FILE" >/dev/null 2>&1; OUTPUT=$(uv run ruff check "$FILE" 2>&1); if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then echo "$OUTPUT" >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0'
